items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Macon, Georgia, that's Vernon Brothers headquarters. Well from Vernon Brothers I went on to David A. Wise, carnival.

ctx.x: Vernon Brothers, and that was a carnival show, but I was playing in the minstrel show, that was connected with the carnival show. And the minstrel show manager at that time was, we used to call him Green River, but his name was Jewel Weaver, out of Dallas, Texas. We called him Green River. He played a big bass on him. But he was the manager of the show. Well that's my first carnival show, that is under Candace. Vernon Brothers. Well I done lots of traveling with them. Where was their headquarters, Texas? Vernon…
Macon, Georgia. Macon, Georgia, that's Vernon Brothers headquarters. Well from Vernon Brothers I went on to David A. Wise, carnival.

What's the name of that one? David A. Wise. That was a carnival show. Went on to him, from him I went to Reuben and Cherry number one. Were those tent shows? All tent shows. All tent shows. From Reuben and Cherry number one I went to Ciara Leggins. From Ciara Leggins I went to Spark Circus. How long did you stay with those different? Well, some of those shows I stayed with them two seasons, some three seasons, some of them one season. You know I fell out of them from show to show. Work with a show this season,…
